labels.name: WinFlag
labels.note: 1 = fight won (set on the frame you win)

labels.name: HalfTimeFlag
labels.note: Set by AwardPrize when a Bash 'n' Dash prize lands at 1:30

labels.name: InFight
labels.note: 1 in fight, 2 fight over (stays set after quitting)

labels.name: RobotSlots
labels.note: Robot slots, 0x698 bytes each. Slot 0 = you. Flags dword at +0 (bit31 active, bit24 house robot, bit21 eliminated, bit17 in pit), X/Y/Z at +8/+C/+10, health +0x658, max health +0x660

labels.name: SpoilsTable
labels.note: Spoils of War table (multiplayer), 12-byte entries, prize id at +4, 81 = none

labels.name: CurrentArena
labels.note: 0 Studio, 1 Melting Pot, 2 Acid Bath, 3 Deep Freeze, 4 Desert Storm, 5 Red Planet Rumble

labels.name: CurrentMode
labels.note: 0 Tournament, 1 Bash 'n' Dash, 2 Mayhem, 3 Gauntlet, 4 Multiplayer/Spoils, 5 Quickstart

labels.name: GauntletChallenge
labels.note: 0 Slalom, 1 Skittles, 2 Long Jump, 3 Sumo Basho, 4 Dump, 5 Drop Zone

labels.name: GameState
labels.note: 0 loading/results, 1 in game, 2 menus (also while paused)

labels.name: MenuState
labels.note: Screen id: 10 quit/restart confirm, 41 pause, 42 pause options, 11 in game

labels.name: SessionPrizeCheats
labels.note: Prizes unlocked by cheat for this session only, 1 bit per prize

labels.name: SaveBlock
labels.note: Save data block; prizes at +0x1C, trophies at +0x0F

labels.name: PrizeBits
labels.note: 81 prizes, 1 bit each. 75-80 = Gold parts (multiplayer only)

labels.name: CustomRobots
labels.note: 5 custom robot slots, 0x20 bytes: +0 in use, +2 name, +0x18 parts

labels.name: TournamentRobot
labels.note: Your robot in the Tournament (0-16 roster, 17-21 custom)

0x080168B4.name: AwardPrize
0x080168B4.note: Awards prize id (0-80) unless already owned: sets its bit in PrizeBits (SaveBlock+0x1C) and plays the unlock sound. Also sets HalfTimeFlag if you are in Bash 'n' Dash at 1:30 and not in multiplayer.

0x0801693C.name: IsPrizeEarned
0x0801693C.note: Returns 1 if prize id's bit is set in PrizeBits.

0x08016990.name: CheatUnlockPrize
0x08016990.note: Session-only unlock: sets the prize bit in SessionPrizeCheats instead of the save.

0x080169D0.name: IsPrizeCheatUnlocked
0x080169D0.note: Returns 1 if prize id's bit is set in SessionPrizeCheats.

0x08023714.name: UnlockAllSecrets
0x08023714.note: With argument 1, loops AwardPrize over every prize 0-80 (the Unlock All Secrets option).

0x0802539C.name: AwardSpoilAfterWin
0x0802539C.note: If WinFlag is 1, awards the prize stored in the current SpoilsTable entry (multiplayer spoils).

0x08027E54.name: PostFightHandler
0x08027E54.note: Runs after a fight. In mode 4 (multiplayer) awards the spoil you won from SpoilsTable unless it is 81 (none), then picks the next screen via MenuState.

0x0802E8A0.name: AwardQueuedPrizes
0x0802E8A0.note: Walks the queue of prizes earned by the reward rules and calls AwardPrize on each.
